name: Tasterr
short_desc: Personalized media discovery for TMDB and Seerr
author: Zachary Arthur
description: Tasterr is a self-hosted, Netflix-style discovery interface for household media stacks. It combines the TMDB catalog with Seerr authentication, library availability, and requests, then learns a separate taste profile for each user.

form_fields.label: TMDB API Key
form_fields.hint: TMDB v3 API key used to browse the movie and TV catalog.

form_fields.label: Seerr Internal URL
form_fields.hint: URL Tasterr can use from inside its container to reach Seerr. Do not use localhost unless Seerr runs in this container.

form_fields.label: Seerr External URL
form_fields.hint: Public or LAN URL that household browsers use to open Seerr.

form_fields.label: Seerr API Key
form_fields.hint: Available in Seerr under Settings > General.

form_fields.label: Tasterr Secret Key
form_fields.hint: Encrypts stored Plex tokens. Keep this value stable across upgrades.
